description: Import a list of contacts into the workspace CRM in one call. Nothing is emailed. This is the first step for mailing a list: import_contacts, then create_campaign (which can take a contactListId), then send_campaign. Duplicate rows are merged (tags unioned), existing contacts are skipped, and counts against the plan's contact limit. Pass `listId` to also add the newly created contacts to a saved contact list.

listId.description: Saved contact list to add the new contacts to

name: import_contacts
